Functions
cpct_sectorWrite

Writes an array of consecutive sectors from memory onto a given track and drive

C Definition

void cpct_sectorWrite (void* src, u8 track, u8 sector, u8 nbSectorsToWrite, u8 driveNumber) __z88dk_callee;

Input Parameters
(2B HL) src

Memory source buffer pointer

(1B D)  sector

Physical starting sector ID

(1B E)  track

Target disk track index

(1B C)  nbSectorsToWrite

Total number of sectors to write

(1B B)  driveNumber

Drive index selection (0 for Drive A, 1 for Drive B)

Assembly call:

call cpct_sectorWrite_asm

Requirements and limitations:

  • The floppy drive motor state is automatically handled.

  • CPU Interrupts are disabled (DI) during execution to protect hardware timings.

Details

Communicates directly with the uPD765A FDC ports (#0xfa7e and #0xfb7e).  Extracts parameters from stack according to __z88dk_callee convention.

Destroyed Register values: AF, BC, DE, HL

Required memory: C-binding wrapper: 8 bytes Complete routine & buffers: 467 bytes (Shared with read implementation)
